item.title: Increased patrols, sobriety checkpoints for Big Game weekend
item.description: ALBANY, N.Y. (NEWS10) -- Law enforcement across the state is increasing patrols in anticipation of celebrations for the Big Game. item.title: Syracuse Hancock International Airport to reach new heights with 2026 plans
item.description: The Syracuse Regional Airport Authority is looking ahead to a busy year with plans for a consolidated rental car facility, cargo development, and a new bag system, as well as increased air service and a positive economic impact on the region.
